# braintrust_user (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Braintrust user by email address or ID. This is useful for referencing users when managing group membership or ACLs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a user by email.
data "braintrust_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

# Alternatively, look up a user by ID.
data "braintrust_user" "bob" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# Use the user data source to manage group membership by email.
resource "braintrust_group" "engineering" {
  name = "Engineering"
  member_users = [
    data.braintrust_user.alice.id,
    data.braintrust_user.bob.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The user's email address. Provide either `email` or `id`.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the user (UUID). Provide either `id` or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) URL of the user's avatar image.
- `created` (String) Date of user creation.
- `family_name` (String) Family (last) name of the user.
- `given_name` (String) Given (first) name of the user.
